tekst:
By Stefan Acevski / info@eurohoops.net
Real Madrid will host Crvena zvezda on Thursday (21:00 CEST) in the 11th round of the EuroLeague, and the visitors encountered a serious problem ahead of this trip.
According to the Mozzart Sport, Crvena zvezda’s center, Christian Koloko, who was born in Cameroon, couldn’t travel with the team to the Spanish capital due to administrative issues.
Koloko also faced problems before the previous round and the trip to Athens for the match against Olympiacos. Now, due to visa issues, he has stayed in Belgrade until the matter is resolved.
However, it is expected that Zvezda will sort everything out by Thursday morning, and if all goes well, Koloko will board a plane and join his teammates.
The former Lakers center recently joined Crvena zvezda, which has won all three games in which Christian played.
